cards.front: Which cranial nerve carries taste from the posterior third of the tongue? [___]
cards.context: The glossopharyngeal nerve also carries general sensation from the pharynx. Its mixed functions explain its role in swallowing and the gag reflex.

reference.title: Cranial Nerve Testing — Anatomy and Physiology; Technique

cards.front: The cranial nerve supplying most pharyngeal and laryngeal muscles is [___].
cards.context: Vagal injury can impair swallowing and voice. The recurrent laryngeal nerve supplies intrinsic laryngeal muscles except cricothyroid, which receives the external superior laryngeal branch.

reference.title: Cranial Nerve Testing — Anatomy and Physiology; Technique

cards.front: The joint linking the distal humerus to the radius and ulna is the [___].
cards.context: The trochlea meets the ulna; the capitulum meets the radial head. These distinct surfaces help orient an elbow image.

cards.front: The nerve marked A carries sensory information for [___].
cards.context: The optic nerve (CN II) carries visual information from the retina. The abducens nerve (CN VI) supplies lateral rectus and controls an eye movement.

reference.title: Cranial Nerves III, IV, and VI: Oculomotor Function
